issues.detail: Covers mostly the happy path and gives no troubleshooting for common failures such as out-of-memory errors, a missing or renamed model repo, failed downloads, or unsupported image formats in the batch loop.

scenarios.name: batch-describe-photos-to-csv
scenarios.rationale: B calls generate() with the required `image=[...]` keyword and reads `.text` from the result; A passes the image list positionally and falls back to a str, so it misses the `image=` keyword requirement. Both load the model once and use load_config, apply_chat_template with num_images=1, and CSV output. B builds the prompt inside the loop, which is a minor inefficiency.

scenarios.name: private-local-vision-server
scenarios.rationale: B hits every rubric item: `--model`, `--host 127.0.0.1` and a port, the note that the default is 0.0.0.0, `--api-key` as an option, `/v1/chat/completions` with an `image_url` part plus a text part, and the OpenAI SDK `base_url`. A uses the correct `image_url` format and mentions the SDK, but it curls `/chat/completions` first and only suggests `/v1/` after a 404. It also says the server has no auth and never mentions `--api-key`.

scenarios.name: lora-finetune-invoice-model
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric closely: it installs `mlx-vlm[train]`, gives the full `mlx_vlm.lora` command with rank and alpha, states the `images`/`question`/`answer` columns, and shows inference through `--adapter-path` and `load(..., adapter_path=...)`. B installs plain `mlx-vlm` without the train extra, omits `--lora-alpha`, and says the dataset needs `images` and `messages` columns instead of the `question`/`answer` columns, though it does show the adapter inference paths and a data-prep script.
